# Historical clinic shell baseline

These inputs are copied byte-for-byte from commit `5da1a9f5279b19a64a53b3d3af9f299f2e12f50f`
for the clinic shell comparison test in shallow CI checkouts. They are
historical inputs, not current implementation or acceptance evidence.

The `.txt` suffix keeps the historical TSX outside TypeScript compilation.
The loader retains the original relative module IDs. Do not reformat these
snapshots or substitute current source.
